sentences.text: Deviation is the error caused by your boat’s own magnetic fields.
Unlike variation, it changes as your heading changes, so it’s recorded on a deviation card listing the error for each heading.
When you take a compass bearing of a landmark, you correct it using the deviation for the boat’s heading, not the direction of the bearing, because deviation depends on how the boat is pointed.
And a handy rule for naming the error: compass least, error east; compass best, error west.
If the compass reads less than magnetic, deviation is east.
